Get CBA Player Base

Source: R/cba.R
cba_player_base.Rd

Season player box (one page of the season player table).

Endpoint: POST https://data-server.cbaleague.com/api/player-base-list (JSON body)

Usage

cba_player_base(
  season,
  match_type_id = 1,
  count_ranger = 1,
  player_ranger = 1,
  team_id = NULL,
  page_number = 1,
  page_size = 100
)

Arguments

season

(required) Required. Season END year (2026 = the 2025-26 season). The API takes the START year (2025), so cba_runtime sends season - 1.

match_type_id

(default 1) Match type id: 1 regular season (default), 2 playoffs, 3 preseason, 4 all-star, 9 relegation play-off (cba_match_types).

count_ranger

(default 1) How counting statistics scale: 1 per game (default), 2 season total, 3 per 36 minutes, 4 per 100 possessions.

player_ranger

(default 1) Which players: 1 all (default), 2 domestic (Chinese) only, 4 foreign only.

team_id

(optional) Optional CBA team id (clubs, stable across seasons and renames) to list one team's players.

page_number

(default 1) Page number of the paged list, from 1.

page_size

(default 100) Rows per page (the site uses 100).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One row per player of the requested page. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sdv-py cba_player_base):

col_nametypedescription
ageintegerAge in years in that season.
assistsdoubleAssists per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
birth_datecharacterDate of birth 'YYYY-MM-DD' (a public player bio field; midnight-suffixed 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00' on player-base-list).
blockeddoubleBlocks per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
cn_aliascharacterPlayer name (Chinese). Names change with the sponsor, the id does not; teamId -> English glossary in cba_glossary.yaml.
field_goalsdoubleField goals made per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
field_goals_at_rim_attempteddoubleAt-the-rim (inside the restricted area) field goals attempted in the season (total), a float.
field_goals_at_rim_madedoubleAt-the-rim field goals made in the season (total), a float.
field_goals_attempteddoubleField goals attempted per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
field_goals_mid_range_attempteddoubleMid-range (two-point shots outside the restricted area) field goals attempted in the season (total), a float.
field_goals_mid_range_madedoubleMid-range field goals made in the season (total), a float.
field_goals_percentagedoubleField-goal percentage. A FRACTION 0-1 (the API sends a percent string such as '39.4%'; the _sort column holds the same fraction).
field_goals_percentage_sortdoubleField-goal percentage as a FRACTION 0-1 for sorting.
foulsdoublePersonal fouls per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
fouls_defensivedoubleDefensive personal fouls in the season (total), a float.
free_throwsdoubleFree throws made per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
free_throws_attempteddoubleFree throws attempted per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
free_throws_percentagedoubleFree-throw percentage. A FRACTION 0-1 (the API sends a percent string such as '39.4%'; the _sort column holds the same fraction).
free_throws_percentage_sortdoubleFree-throw percentage as a FRACTION 0-1 for sorting.
game_start_numintegerGames started (Chinese text).
minutesdoubleMinutes: per game; a whole-season total integer on the offensive/defensive/shot lists (827). A number (the API sends it as display text).
nationalitycharacterNationality (Chinese country name; see the nationality code table for every value seen and its English name). Chinese country names seen: China; United States; Canada; France; Chinese Taipei; Iran; Nigeria; Jordan.
numbercharacterJersey number as a string.
player_idintegerplayerId (key space: CBA persons, stable across seasons and clubs; 3-9 digits, older players have short ids (393433) and newer ones 100xxxxxx). Joins the player box routes, the season player lists and getPlayersByScheduleId. Not a team id.
player_timesdoubleGames played (Chinese text), a float (39.0).
player_times2characterUnobserved: null in every sample.
pointsdoublePoints per game when countRanger is 1 (the request value); other countRanger values change the unit (2 total, 3 per 36 minutes, 4 per 100 possessions). A number (the API sends it as display text).
positioncharacterPosition label (Chinese). Eras differ: coarse (Chinese text) (guard) / (Chinese text) (forward) / (Chinese text) (center) in older seasons, five-way (Chinese text) (point guard) / (Chinese text) (shooting guard) / (Chinese text) (small forward) / (Chinese text) (power forward) / (Chinese text) (center) in newer ones; dual positions are joined with '/' (e.g. (Chinese text)). Label glosses: C = (Chinese text); C/PF = (Chinese text); F = (Chinese text); G = (Chinese text); PF = (Chinese text); PF/C = (Chinese text); PF/SF = (Chinese text); PG = (Chinese text); PG/SG = (Chinese text); SF = (Chinese text); SF/PF = (Chinese text); SF/SG = (Chinese text); SG = (Chinese text); SG/PG = (Chinese text); SG/SF = (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text); (Chinese text).
position_numdoublePosition as a number 1-5 (1 point guard, 2 shooting guard, 3 small forward, 4 power forward, 5 center); a fraction such as 4.5 averages a dual position; typed as float.
rank_sortcharacterUnobserved: null in every sample.
reboundsdoubleTotal rebounds per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
rebounds_defensivedoubleDefensive rebounds per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
rebounds_offensivedoubleOffensive rebounds per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
schedule_idintegerCBA game id (key space: CBA games, ONE global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx across seasons and match types; the {scheduleId} of every game route). Stamped by the runtime from the request; null on a body parsed without it.
seasonintegerSeason START year (2025 = the 2025-26 season). The sdv season key is the END year = season + 1; map at the boundary.
secondsdoubleSeconds: per-game average; a whole-season total integer elsewhere. A number (the API sends it as display text).
stealsdoubleSteals per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
team_cn_aliascharacterTeam short name (Chinese) in that season. Names change with the sponsor, the id does not; teamId -> English glossary in cba_glossary.yaml.
team_idintegerteamId (key space: CBA clubs; 5 digits 29115-29140 for the long-standing clubs, 9 digits for newer ones (100074683 = Ningbo); stable across seasons and club renames, but the display name changes with the sponsor: 29128 = 'Zhejiang Guangsha' under many sponsor names, (Chinese text) in 2025-26). Joins getTeam / teamList and the team and player routes. Not a player or schedule id.
three_point_attempteddoubleThree-pointers attempted per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
three_point_goalsdoubleThree-pointers made per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).
three_point_percentagedoubleThree-point percentage. A FRACTION 0-1 (the API sends a percent string such as '39.4%'; the _sort column holds the same fraction).
three_point_percentage_sortdoubleThree-point percentage as a FRACTION 0-1 for sorting.
turnoversdoubleTurnovers per game when countRanger is 1. A number (the API sends it as display text).

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the routes that cbaleague.com's own data site (a Vue single-page app) calls. SportsDataverse has not ruled on the site's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart per host; keep use small.

  • Access: every response body is AES-128-ECB encrypted with a public key shipped in the site's front-end bundle; the runtime decrypts it with digest::AES() (digest is a suggested package: install it to use these wrappers) and refuses anything that does not decrypt. The host blocks datacenter IPs at TCP: set the environment variable CBA_PROXY (or options(hoopR.proxy = ...)) to a residential proxy URL; it is never printed or put in a condition. Without a proxy the request goes direct and, from a datacenter, fails within seconds (a 5 s connect timeout, no retry of a refused or timed-out connect). Where direct access works (a residential IP), set CBA_DIRECT=1 for the full 60 s timeout and retries.

  • Seasons: the API's season is the START year; every season argument here is the END year (2026 = 2025-26) and is sent as season - 1. Columns named season keep the wire value (the START year, so the sdv END year is season + 1). The season list reaches 1995-96; box data before 2009-10 is unverified.

  • Coverage: game wrappers serve FINISHED games only. Each first reads the game report header (cached per session), and an unfinished game raises hoopR_asset_fetch. Box, period, roster and best-player bodies are checked against that header (points sum to the score, team ids match, advanced rows are box players). Play-by-play is served one period per request: every period is fetched, and a partial set, an unordered clock or a final score the plays do not reach is refused. Play-by-play is verified on 2017-18 and 2025-26 only and is absent for 2009-10 (hoopR_no_data). There are NO shot x/y coordinates in this API (shot location exists only as team and player zone splits), and play-by-play has no player or team ids (Chinese sentence text plus surnames). Box data has 12-minute quarters in 2009-10 and 2017-18 and 10-minute quarters in 2025-26. The women's CBA is not covered (no official source).

  • Not game data: cba_game_team_shots() and cba_game_team_four() answer the two teams' SEASON tables (the shot zones are the teams' current profile; the four factors are the previous season), whichever game is asked for. The reference lists (cba_team_options(), cba_team_counts()) and cba_report_status() are not echoed by the API, so their scope is unchecked.

  • Duplicate rows: in some games (2025-26 game 100105799) the advanced-box and extras routes repeat player rows (26 rows for 12 players), and the repeats are not always copies. cba_player_advanced() and cba_player_extras() keep the FIRST row per player_id.

  • Text fields are Chinese (names, play-by-play sentences, position and nationality labels). The column descriptions here are ASCII; sdv-py's tools/codegen/notes/cba_glossary.yaml holds the full English glossaries.

  • Personal data: the operator ids (createdBy / lastModifiedBy, one holds a mobile number) and any bare mobile-number string are removed from every body. Players' public bio fields (birth date, height, weight) are kept.

  • Ids: schedule_id (games, one global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx), team_id (clubs, stable across sponsor renames), player_id (persons) and match_type_id are integers. The roster registration id of cba_rosters() is a 19-digit integer that an R integer or double cannot hold exactly, so it is kept as its exact digits (character).

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a game without play-by-play), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer id or season, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-200, including HTTP 500, which this API answers for a body it dislikes and which is not retried; a dead connection; an empty or undecryptable body; an unfinished game; a body for another game, team, season or day), all inheriting hoopR_error. HTTP 429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried, up to three attempts. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.
